lines.name: Boulevard Line

lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: south on Sunset Way beyond y -780; north on Harbour Road beyond y 320 (termini and depot off-sheet)

notes: S1 stays as drawn, so it is not listed. T1 now runs straight through the circus island at x 0, eases to x 5 in Crown Avenue, makes an R50 turn onto Crown Road west and leaves the sheet at x -400. The balloon loop is dropped (no on-sheet end, so T-L1 no longer applies). Path id 'trunk' is kept so the stops still attach. Not checker-run: all geometry is hand-checked only.

Tide's Sky Loop round the ring is rejected. To stay on a 24 m ring road through a 90° corner, an R70 curve needs the alignment about 20.5 m out from the inside kerb. With beams 6 m apart, the inner beam swings over corner plots, which breaks S-C1. It would also bring back the loop the plan retires (open question 3).

T2 is not Harbour Road only. That road ends at Comet Row, short of the south sheet edge (T-C1), and a 24 m street can't fit an R25 balloon loop (T-L1). So T2 runs south off-sheet on Sunset Way, along Market Street, then up Harbour Road off-sheet north (N-D1). It brings rocket-west, lantern-west and the docks within the 250 m reach.

The R50 corners fit by running off-centre: Sunset Way x -349, Harbour Road x 309, Crown Avenue x 5, Crown Road y 289. Market Street runs at y -406 in the west and y -414 in the east, shifting between x -100 and 100. Both tracks (±1.8) stay within the kerbs. I checked this against road widths only; the checker's junction polygons may differ.

Interchange spacing for Vantage, within 150 m: T1 and S1 at Crown Circus. T2 and S1 at Harbour Road, about 40 m from the Harbour station (340, 0). T1 and T2 at the Boulevard and Market Street crossing (0, -410), next to the Records stop.

Source conflict for Aster: the concept note still says T1 turns on an R28 balloon loop and that the circus is the one interchange. The 'why' notes describe an older tram. Open question 2 (end T1 at the circus or run on north) is still open. I followed tide's draft (run through); Sky should confirm, and the notes need updating.

Next steps: Vantage places and re-projects the stops (300–500 m apart, plus interchange stops), then runs bun tools/plan/cli.ts. If T-C1 fails at a corner, send it back to me (Datum) with the failing vertex. No rule was loosened.
